title: Welcome to the R-Ladies Sheffield Chapter
description:
Hello! Welcome to the Sheffield Chapter of R-Ladies. We are hosting our first meet up on the 23rd of October to introduce ourselves, talk a bit about the R-Ladies goal and what we'll be doing in this chapter. We will finish with an autumnal Tidy Tuesday activity together so bring your laptops if possible but we can also share.

After the session which we've planned to take an hour, we'll move on to a more relaxed setting at the University Arms where we can just take some time to get to know each other!

In the Hicks Building, we'll be in Lecture Theatre 11. See you then! :)

title: Using R in the Pharmaceutical Industry with Sophie Lee
description:
**University of Sheffield Hicks Building, Lecture Theatre 11**

Hi everyone! Sorry it's been a while and it's lovely to see we've been joined by some new members in the meantime.

Please join us on the 8th of October at 17:30 in the University of Sheffield Hicks Building (room number to come) to hear our lovely Sophie speak about using R in the pharmaceutical industry. It will be a really interesting presentation with opportunities to ask questions!

We will also welcome any ideas for what you want to see in future sessions and we can plan more events from there.
